scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run stage && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lantern --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:server && npm run deploy
scripts.d1:migrate: cd server && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0002_extensions.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0003_tone_refactor.sql --remote
scripts.d1:migrate:local: cd server && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql --local && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0002_extensions.sql --local && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0003_tone_refactor.sql --local
scripts.d1:migrate:local:0003: cd server && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=./migrations/0003_tone_refactor.sql --local
scripts.d1:seed: cd server && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=../scripts/seed-d1.sql --remote
scripts.d1:seed:local: cd server && wrangler d1 execute lantern-db --file=../scripts/seed-d1.sql --local
